tables.name: companies
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE companies (
            cik TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            entity_type TEXT,
            sic TEXT,
            sic_description TEXT,
            owner_org TEXT,
            insider_transaction_for_owner_exists INTEGER,
            insider_transaction_for_issuer_exists INTEGER,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            ein TEXT,
            lei TEXT,
            description TEXT,
            website TEXT,
            investor_website TEXT,
            category TEXT,
            fiscal_year_end TEXT,
            state_of_incorporation TEXT,
            state_of_incorporation_description TEXT,
            phone TEXT,
            flags TEXT,
            former_names TEXT,
            created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )

tables.name: company_tickers
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE company_tickers (
            cik TEXT NOT NULL,
            ticker TEXT NOT NULL,
            exchange TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (cik, ticker),
            FOREIGN KEY (cik) REFERENCES companies(cik)
        )

tables.name: company_addresses
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE company_addresses (
            cik TEXT NOT NULL,
            address_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'mailing' or 'business'
            street1 TEXT,
            street2 TEXT,
            city TEXT,
            state_or_country TEXT,
            zip_code TEXT,
            state_or_country_description TEXT,
            is_foreign_location INTEGER,
            foreign_state_territory TEXT,
            country TEXT,
            country_code TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (cik, address_type),
            FOREIGN KEY (cik) REFERENCES companies(cik)
        )

tables.name: filings
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE filings (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            cik TEXT NOT NULL,
            accession_number TEXT NOT NULL,
            filing_date DATE,
            report_date DATE,
            acceptance_date_time TEXT,
            act TEXT,
            form TEXT,
            file_number TEXT,
            film_number TEXT,
            items TEXT,
            core_type TEXT,
            size INTEGER,
            is_xbrl INTEGER,
            is_inline_xbrl INTEGER,
            primary_document TEXT,
            primary_doc_description TEXT,
            created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            UNIQUE (cik, accession_number),
            FOREIGN KEY (cik) REFERENCES companies(cik)
        )

message.content: I have clean annual revenue figures for FY2019–FY2025 (fiscal years ending Jan 31). Now let me compute the year-over-year growth rates.

# Revenue Growth Trend — Snowflake Inc. (CIK 1640147)

**Overall trend: revenue grew every year, but the growth rate decelerated sharply and steadily** — from triple-digit percentage growth in the early years to high-20s/low-30s percent by the latest fiscal year.

Using the consolidated `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax` (USD, fiscal years ending January 31):

| Fiscal year (end date) | Revenue (USD) | YoY growth |
|---|---|---|
| FY2019 (2019-01-31) | $96.7M | — |
| FY2020 (2020-01-31) | $264.7M | +173.9% |
| FY2021 (2021-01-31) | $592.0M | +123.6% |
| FY2022 (2022-01-31) | $1,219.3M | +106.0% |
| FY2023 (2023-01-31) | $2,065.7M | +69.4% |
| FY2024 (2024-01-31) | $2,806.5M | +35.9% |
| FY2025 (2025-01-31) | $3,626.4M | +29.2% |

**Key points:**
- Revenue rose from $96.7M (FY2019) to $3,626.4M (FY2025), roughly a 37.5× increase over six years.
- The growth rate fell in every consecutive year: 173.9% → 123.6% → 106.0% → 69.4% → 35.9% → 29.2%. The deceleration was steepest between FY2023 and FY2024 (a drop of ~33.5 percentage points).
- The absolute dollar increase per year kept rising until FY2024→FY2025, when the incremental gain (~$820M) was still large but the percentage rate was the lowest in the series.

**Basis and caveats:** Figures are the latest applicable annual disclosures; each year's value is consistent across the multiple 10-K filings that repeat it (e.g., FY2025 revenue of $3,626,396,000 from the FY2025 10-K, accession 0001640147-25-000052, fact id 2509712; FY2024 $2,806,489,000, fact id 2509703; FY2023 $2,065,659,000, fact id 2509691; FY2022 $1,219,327,000, fact id 2509678; FY2021 $592,049,000, fact id 2509665; FY2020 $264,748,000, fact id 2509655; FY2019 $96,666,000, fact id 2509651). Growth rates are my calculations from these reported values, not directly disclosed fields. The database snapshot ends at FY2025 (2025-01-31), so no later period is reflected.
